    SELECT
        "District Code",
        "District Name",
        AVG(CASE WHEN yr_asc <= 3 THEN "Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" END) AS avg_earliest_three,
        AVG(CASE WHEN yr_desc <= 3 THEN "Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" END) AS avg_latest_three,
        GROUP_CONCAT(CASE WHEN yr_asc <= 3 THEN acad_year END ORDER BY acad_year, ', ') AS earliest_years,
        GROUP_CONCAT(CASE WHEN yr_desc <= 3 THEN acad_year END ORDER BY acad_year, ', ') AS latest_years
    FROM year_ranks
    GROUP BY "District Code", "District Name"
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT acad_year) >= 3
),
charter_stats AS (
    SELECT
        "District Code",
        SUM(CASE WHEN "Charter School (Y/N)" = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT CDSCode) AS charter_prop
    FROM frpm_clean
    GROUP BY "District Code"
),

)
